answer.summary: E2E job failed at startup, not in a test. The app container exited because Flyway found two migrations with the same version V6_20261118120000000. The change adds V6_20261118120000000__Catalog_connector_injector_contracts.java, which collides with an existing migration of the same version. This is deterministic and will repeat on every run until the version is renamed.
